conditions.name: timeout

conditions.desc: wie C3, aber QA_SUMMARY_TIMEOUT_MS=3000 / OPEN_WEIGHT_LLM_SUMMARY_TIMEOUT_MS=1000 → Client-Timeout gewinnt
